title: SupervisorAdvisory
description: One typed advisory written by the per-project supervisor (Layer 2). Append-only entry in logs/meta/<project>/observations.jsonl. Severity is informational; the auto-intervention policy decides whether to escalate. Mirrors backend/Services/Supervisor/SupervisorContract.cs::SupervisorAdvisory.

createdAt.description: UTC timestamp at which the advisory was emitted by the supervisor.

project.description: Project name as it appears in WatchPaths and runner status. Matches ProjectRunnerStatus.projectName.

severity.description: Informational severity. Even High does not by itself trigger an automatic intervention; auto-intervention is gated and opt-in per project.

source.description: Origin of the advisory. The auto-intervention policy filters out advisories whose source is AutoIntervention or User to prevent feedback loops.

topic.description: Short kebab-case label, e.g. no-progress, error-burst, quota-critical, tool-call-repeat. Topics map to known auto-intervention actions when enabled.

message.description: One-line human-readable description of what the supervisor saw. Under 200 characters. Plain prose, no markdown.

jobId.description: If the advisory pertains to a specific running job, that job's id. Null when the observation is project-wide.
